intent: An anchored, non-modal typography dialog: header + preview, segmented alignment/vertical/decoration/case rows, a weight input+slider, and line-height/letter-spacing metrics. Floats beside the inspector rail.
guidance: Launch it from a trigger in the inspector; it anchors to the panel's left edge and floats beside the rail, never inside scroll content. It is non-modal — it won't trap focus or block the canvas, so nothing critical should live only here. It owns no document state: drive it with `value` and route every `onChange` patch through the host's undo/redo and persistence. Show mixed selections as mixed rather than fabricating a value, and pass `readOnly` for locked selections so values stay readable but inert. It surfaces only host-backed properties; unsupported axes are omitted rather than shipped disabled.

anatomy.description: 40px bar with the "Type settings" title; doubles as the drag handle for the floating surface.
Icon button at the header's right (aria-label "Close type settings") that calls onClose.
Static box showing the fixed word "Preview" — it names the surface and is deliberately not a live type sample (#499).
Bordered block of four segmented radio groups: Alignment, Vertical trim, Decoration, Case.
Numeric font-weight input (1-1000) paired with a slider; the handle switches to a stroke variant on a mixed selection.
Side-by-side Line height and Letter spacing (% suffix) numeric inputs, each with a lead icon.

use_when: Editing the typography of a selected text object from the inspector — alignment, weight, decoration, case, line height, letter spacing.
dont_use_when: A blocking, focus-trapping confirmation — use Modal.
A single inline property control — drop SegmentedControl / NumericInput / Slider straight into the panel row.

slots.trigger: The launch control the dialog captures as its positioning anchor.

states: read-only (every control disabled; sr-only polite hint to unlock the selection)
mixed (a field differs across the selection — no active segment / value shown)
justify unavailable (Justify segment disabled with a tooltip when the model can't justify)
keyframe active (weight / line height / letter spacing keyframe toggle lit)

tokens.note: No hex literals — colors, radii, shadow, and font family bind to tokens. Type sizes/weights, spacing, and control dimensions are hardcoded literals, not tokens: e.g. 11px/9px/16px labels, font-[450]/[550], 40px header, 32px rows, 24px close, 240px width, 8px side offset, and the weight axis 1-1000 step 1.

a11y.role: dialog (non-modal — aria-modal=false; portalled above the canvas, focus not trapped, dismisses on Esc or outside interaction).
a11y.label: aria-label "Type settings" on the dialog surface.
a11y.close: Header X button, aria-label "Close type settings".
a11y.segmentedGroups: Alignment / Vertical trim / Decoration / Case are role=radiogroup of role=radio items; the group aria-label announces "Mixed" or the active label instead of a fabricated value, and a disabled option is labelled "…: unavailable".
a11y.numericInputs: Font weight, line height, and letter spacing each carry an explicit aria-label.
a11y.readOnly: A polite sr-only live region prompts to unlock the selection to edit.

code.example: <TypeSettingsDialog open={open} onClose={close} trigger={<button aria-label="Type settings" />} value={value} onChange={patch => applyType(patch)} />
